subject: general
question: Ganesh was taking a walk with his mother’s brother’s father’s granddaughter. Who was he walking with?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68649cacfa98245f0ceb36f716a73c5c632a9f59d024076540dec2107071feb2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2717e695f04dd90865f2c39069f192e6452a5e4b014564d3e64e105442f8e602.png] 

 
• Ganesh was taking a walk with his mother’s brother’s → Mother's brother is Uncle of Ganesh.
 
• Mother's brother's father is Grandfather of Ganesh.
 
• Mother’s brother’s father’s granddaughter → Grandfather's granddaughter is daughter of Ganesh's uncle.
 
• Therefore, Ganesh is walking with his cousin.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Cousin"**.
